specification: Stranded tinned copper, silicone insulation, about 0.8 mm outer diameter, at least six colours
candidate_part: any 30 AWG silicone kit or spool (for example Adafruit 30 AWG silicone spools)
qty: 1 kit, at least 6 colours x 10 m
decision_or_reason: Safe whatever connector is chosen; the thin flexible silicone insulation suits 1.2 mm pads and tight routing
needed_for: tapping test pads; first prototype harness; bench leads

specification: 0.5 mm solder, no-clean flux gel or pen, 1.5 mm desoldering braid, fine conical tip (0.2 to 0.4 mm) if not owned
decision_or_reason: Pads are 1.2 mm with 2 mm pitch rows; low heat and a fine tip protect the original board

specification: 1, 1.5, 2 and 3 mm, 2:1; plus adhesive-lined 3:1 for strain relief
decision_or_reason: Insulation of joints and strain relief at the solder end

specification: 5 to 10 mm wide
decision_or_reason: Mask neighbouring pads and components while soldering; insulate bare joints

specification: 10 kOhm, 1 percent, 0.25 W metal film (through-hole)
decision_or_reason: The LX-01 plan calls for 10 kOhm per axis; spares for the other axes and for the S3-only reference test

item: Ceramic capacitors for the LX-01 interface
specification: 100 nF, X7R, 16 V or more (through-hole)
decision_or_reason: The LX-01 plan calls for 100 nF at the S3 end of each axis

specification: SMD-style clip probes, 0.5 to 1 mm tip, with leads compatible with your meter
decision_or_reason: Lets pads be probed during characterisation (M2, M4) without soldering to the original board

specification: Self-laminating wrap labels or printable heat-shrink markers, 6 to 10 mm
decision_or_reason: Issue 5 requires every wire to carry its ID; label as you build

specification: 8 positions, 1.25 mm pitch, GHR-08V-S housing with SSHL-002T-P0.2 contacts, about 28 AWG, 150 mm, single-ended if offered
decision_or_reason: Evaluation only: judges size and latch feel against the real board. The family is not final until D1

item: Hirose DF13 board-side header, alternative evaluation lot
